resources.string: This release adds Teapot support, subscription sorting, backups, and a new app icon.
Use Nitter or Teapot. If an instance is unavailable, choose another in the app and keep your current page.
Search saved accounts, sort by username or subscription date, or arrange them manually. Long-press the subscription button to assign groups.
Export subscriptions, groups, settings and instance options. Preview backups before restoring, or import subscriptions from QuaX.
Return from a tweet to the same timeline position. Theme changes keep your page.
If you find the app useful, please consider supporting its development through the donation section.
